description: Reduce the anchor points of paths while keeping their shape (Object > Path > Simplify), with Simplify's curve precision, corner angle threshold and straight lines options. Runs Illustrator's own Simplify through a temporary Action, with its dialog closed

angleThreshold.description: Degrees: corners sharper than this stay corners. Default 0

curvePrecision.description: Percent: how closely the result follows the original; lower removes more anchors. Default 50

straightLines.description: Replace curves with straight segments. Default false

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: simplify_path
title: Simplify Path
